steps.send: Write convert.py that reads data.csv and writes out.json: a JSON list with one object per row, keyed by the header, with age as an integer. Run it once so out.json exists.

graders.run: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('out.json')); assert len(d)==4 and d[0]=={'name':'Ada','age':36,'city':'London'}, d"
graders.name: its own output

graders.run: python3 convert.py && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('out.json')); assert d==[{'name':'Kim','age':51,'city':'Seoul'},{'name':'Ola','age':19,'city':'Oslo'}], d"
graders.name: hidden data
